about: Season of Discovery Phase 8 best-in-slot gear for Elemental and two-hand Enhancement shaman, pulled 2026-10-27 from Wowhead's SoD BiS guides. It stands in for 'future' Forever raid gear. stats keys are Wowhead's jsonEquip keys: spldmg = spell power, *pct = percent, mlehastepct = melee haste %, splhastepct = spell haste %. Item stats only, with no enchants, consumables or buffs.
picks: First 'Best' row per slot. Wowhead lists Mirage (a two-hand staff) and the shield Demon's Folly; they can't be worn together, so the caster set uses Mirage and leaves out the shield. Wowhead's Enhancement list has two-hand and dual-wield variants; Forever has no shaman dual wield, so this uses the two-hand variant.
forever_caveats: Set bonuses depend on SoD runes (Static Shock, Lava Lash, Overload chance, 10-stack Maelstrom) or on Undead targets. Don't model them.
SoD gear carries a lot of haste (28% spell / 27% melee in total). Whether Forever has a haste stat is unknown, so run with haste on and with haste off.

Equip and use effects worth modeling as written: Natural Alignment Crystal, Totem of Thunder, Totem of Pyroclastic Thunder, Scarlet Smashbringer's Strength proc. Scarlet Smashbringer's GCD -0.5s and Infusion of Souls' haste-reduced GCD are SoD-style effects; run them both ways.
Mirage's Mirage proc (arcane damage) and swap-places effect can be skipped.
